objective: Stop Bill HTTP 500 responses from echoing database, file, multipart, serialization, and reconciliation Display details while preserving public validation and feature-local envelopes.

architecture.owner: crate-private src/backend/http/bill_routes BillInternalErrorKind and internal failure projection
production_paths: transaction picture multipart, byte read, directory creation, file write, and file removal
reconciliation query serialization/internal errors and PostgreSQL statement reads
quick-add category rule and category refresh persistence

closed_public_messages.database: Rust bills route runtime DB error

retained_contracts: all existing REST paths and 400, 404, and 500 status decisions
picture success/error, batch failure result, and reconciliation compatibility envelope shapes
all public 400 validation messages and reconciliation parse order
PostgreSQL user scope, schema, queries, transactions, writers, and integer-cent amount semantics
rejected_expansion: one universal response envelope that would erase feature-local compatibility fields
a core or DB transport error carrier
a parallel typed BillCreateDraft while the existing PostgreSQL mutation already owns normalization
a trait, service, port, UnitOfWork, cache, transaction owner, or repository-wide error framework

red.result: failed at compile time because the existing picture and reconciliation internal-error functions accepted only one echoable error string

cargo_test_workspace.result: passed against per-test isolated PostgreSQL databases

review.standards: passed: safe public 500 allowlist, server-only structured diagnostics, unchanged user scope/status/envelopes/cents, no trait/service/port or parallel carrier
review.spec: passed: all four accepted production families use the closed projection, public 400 contracts and reconciliation parse order remain pinned

verification.money_review: No amount field, conversion, storage, or API amount contract changed; existing integer-cent semantics remain untouched.
verification.delivery_evidence: Pending exact-head Gitea PR, Actions, squash merge, and source-branch deletion.

residual_risks: Other HTTP domains retain their own error policies and require independent evidence before any repository-wide consolidation.
Existing no-cause db_error_response call sites remain generic but do not record the discarded cause; observability widening is a separate slice.
BillCreateDraft remains a raw DB-boundary carrier because introducing a second typed draft would currently duplicate PostgresBillMutation rather than deepen a proven seam.

environment_hygiene.provider_strategy: No OCR provider, LLM, payment, or other paid external call is executed by this slice.
environment_hygiene.secrets: Tests use synthetic error markers; no credential, request body, header, or transaction payload is added to logs or committed. Underlying error Display diagnostics remain server-only and can contain implementation detail, so log access remains an operational trust boundary.
